events.name: Cory Rasch Invitational Xtreme Bulls
events.info: Cory Rasch Invitational-Xtreme Bulls returns to F&M Bank Arena in Clarksville for its fourth year! Get ready for a night of heart-pounding, edge-of-your-seat action as professional bull riders take on some of the toughest bulls on the planet. New this year, Mutton Bustin' will bring even more excitement to the arena as young riders take on their own wild ride! Before the main event, Lawson Harris will take the stage in the arena, setting the tone for an unforgettable night of music and entertainment. Fans can expect bone-crushing excitement, thrilling rides, spectacular spills, rocking music, and explosive pyrotechnics throughout the event. Experience the unmatched athleticism, adrenaline, and entertainment of professional bull riding - all on one dirt floor and unlike any other major professional sport. Don't miss the Cory Rasch Invitational-Xtreme Bulls - where the action is bigger, the rides are tougher, and the excitement is nonstop!

events.name: Elmo's Got The Moves - Photo Experience
events.info: Meet the Characters of ELMO'S GOT THE MOVES! In this exclusive post show experience, you and your family will have the opportunity to make a lasting memory of your visit by taking a photo alongside characters from ELMO'S GOT THE MOVES! Here's how it works: Photo Experience ticket purchasers should go to the Will Call window at the Box Office on the show day to pick up their photo experience passes and after-show instructions. Each adult and child in a group must have a Photo Experience ticket to attend and participate in the Photo Experience. The Photo Experience will start shortly after the end of show. Please make sure to bring your camera, as you will want to capture every moment!
events.pleaseNote: Parents, please note that while most children are excited to meet their favorite characters up-close, others can be frightened. If your child is scared or hesitant to meet the characters we recommend moving to the back of the line; This will allow your child the extra time they may need to warm up to the characters and see how they interact with other children present. **Admission to the performance is not included in the Photo Experience ticket. This is a separate upgrade that must be purchased in advance. **Children aged 12 and under must be accompanied by a Parent/Guardian. Each Child, Parent or Guardian must have a show ticket as well as a Photo Experience ticket to attend.

events.name: Cirque Musica Holiday Wonderland
events.info: CIRQUE MUSICA HOLIDAY WONDERLAND BRINGS THE MAGIC TO F&M BANK ARENA ON DEC 11, 2026! This holiday season, follow our heroes as they are transported into a dazzling winter wonderland where time seems to stand still. With each daring act, they grow younger, rediscovering the job, imagination, and spirit of the holidays they thought they had lost. This brand new production blends world class circus artistry with your favorite holiday music for a show unlike anything you've experienced. Breathtaking acrobatics, soaring aerial performances, and heart pounding feats bring the season's most beloved melodies to life, delivering an unforgettable holiday experience for the whole family. Don't miss your chance to be part of the magic! Join us at F&M Bank Arena on Dec 11, 2026 for a night of wonder, excitement, and holiday cheer.

events.name: Ultimate Fan Pass: 30-min Exclusive On-court Access From 5:30pm-6:00pm
events.info: TICKET TO MAIN EVENT ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer to the action with the all-new Ultimate Fan Pass - a limited-capacity, 30-minute pregame on-court experience featuring the Harlem Globetrotters and their Rivals. Be first through the doors and first on the court, where you get exclusive access up close with the players, learn trick shots from the pros, get one-of-a-kind photos, and kick off your own tip-off party before the rest of the crowd arrives. Ultimate Fan Pass guests also get first access to the merchandise stands before the lines form. A separate game ticket is required and is not included with this experience. Minors must be accompanied by an adult who also holds an Ultimate Fan Pass. Soft- or rubber-soled shoes are required on court. The on-court experience begins 90 minutes before game time. Late arrivals may miss some or all of the experience and are not eligible for refunds.

events.info: HARLEM GLOBETROTTERS: RIVALRY TOUR Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now.
events.pleaseNote: A warning to any fans with light sensitivity that strobing effects will be used during light shows within the Harlem Globetrotters game. Please visit venue website for additional information: https://www.myfmbankarena.com/plan-your-visit
